6497.title: Anchored side replies retry at an older checkpoint
6497.rootCauseOneLine: Side chat retries an unavailable anchored fork without sourceSeqEnd, silently selecting the preceding completed checkpoint.
6497.proposedFix: Distinguish unavailable-anchor reasons and reject unfinished-turn anchors without dropping sourceSeqEnd; preserve explicitly supported pre-session behavior.
6497.caveats: Real built-in plugin RPC, real SQLite and outgoing provider descriptor verified twice; no live model, native rollout or browser verification. No automatic fix: preserving fallback needs an error-contract distinction or a product decision.
